blocks.text: A butterfly and a grasshopper are removed from the forest and taken to an apartment in the city. Here, they befriend a spider who tries to help them on the long journey back home, which is fraught with dangerous challenges. This innovative and engrossing animated adventure transports us into a familiar world, albeit from the microcosmic perspective of its protagonists.
Doors will open 30 minutes before the screening start time.
Our house lights will remain on a low level throughout the screening, and the volume will be turned slightly down.
You will be able to leave the auditorium and return during the screening.
You will be able to make noise.
We will provide a quiet space for you to use near the auditorium.
You are welcome to take refreshments into the cinema but no hot food please. For information on BFI Bar & Kitchen and BFI Riverfront please see our food and drink page .

blocks.text: Tickets start from £10 for all screenings and events in London, with concessions available for many screenings. Booking information and ticket prices .
For non-Members we charge £1 per ticket for online and phone bookings, up to £3 per transaction. There’s no booking fee if you buy tickets at the box office.
If you’re aged 16 to 25, sign up for free to BFI 25 and Under for a chance to get £6 tickets (without booking fees) to all screenings and events, subject to availability.
More tickets may become available for these screenings before and during the festival. Find out about extra ticket releases and standby queues .
